blocks.text: Eastern Hillsides Homes for Sale in Chilliwack BC | Eastern Hillsides Real Estate

parts.t: Eastern Hillsides is one of Chilliwack's growing communities, known for its scenic mountain views, newer developments, and peaceful hillside setting. This neighbourhood offers a mix of modern detached homes, new construction, and spacious properties that appeal to families, professionals, and buyers looking for a quieter lifestyle surrounded by nature.

Eastern Hillsides provides convenient access for commuters while still offering a sense of privacy and space. Residents enjoy nearby parks, hiking trails, schools, and easy access to Chilliwack's shopping and everyday amenities.

blocks.text: Schools, Parks & Commuting in Eastern Hillsides

parts.t: Families looking at homes for sale in Eastern Hillsides are served by East Chilliwack Elementary, Little Mountain Elementary, Rosedale Traditional Community School (K–8), and Chilliwack Secondary (plus the new SD33 east-side elementary scheduled for September 2027). Outdoor recreation and community amenities nearby include Allan Creek Park, Forest Gate Park, The Falls Golf Club, hillside view trails, and nearby Cheam Lake Wetlands Regional Park. For commuters and transit riders, the area is served by direct highway access via Highway 1 Exit 123 (Prest Road) and nearby BC Transit connections in Chilliwack Proper East.

blocks.text: Zoning, Land Use Plans & Buyer Due Diligence in Eastern Hillsides

parts.t: Land use and building permits in Eastern Hillsides are regulated by the Eastern Hillsides Comprehensive Development Plan (OCP Schedule C), Development Permit Area 2 (Hillside and Upland geotechnical slope, ravine setback, and drainage requirements), and ALR edge policies. Before removing subjects on a property in Eastern Hillsides, verify the title search (checking for statutory building schemes, easements, geotechnical or floodplain covenants, and freehold vs. leasehold tenure) and estimate your closing taxes with our

Which schools serve Eastern Hillsides in Chilliwack School District 33?

Schools serving or located near Eastern Hillsides include East Chilliwack Elementary, Little Mountain Elementary, Rosedale Traditional Community School (K–8), and Chilliwack Secondary (plus the new SD33 east-side elementary scheduled for September 2027). Because SD33 catchment boundaries go by street address, always verify a specific property using the official SD33 School Locator before removing subjects.
What parks, trails, and recreation facilities are near Eastern Hillsides?
Residents of Eastern Hillsides have access to Allan Creek Park, Forest Gate Park, The Falls Golf Club, hillside view trails, and nearby Cheam Lake Wetlands Regional Park. See our

How are roads, highway access, and public transit in Eastern Hillsides?

Key road corridors serving Eastern Hillsides include Preset Road, Marble Hill Road, Falls Court, Legacy Drive, and Highway 1 Exit 123 (Prest Road) and Exit 129 (Annis Road). Public transit connections include direct highway access via Highway 1 Exit 123 (Prest Road) and nearby BC Transit connections in Chilliwack Proper East.
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or hazard rules apply in Eastern Hillsides?

Properties in Eastern Hillsides are governed by the Eastern Hillsides Comprehensive Development Plan (OCP Schedule C), Development Permit Area 2 (Hillside and Upland geotechnical slope, ravine setback, and drainage requirements), and ALR edge policies. Before writing an offer, check the parcel's exact zoning, Development Permit Area overlays, and floodplain elevation requirements.
Are homes in Eastern Hillsides freehold or leasehold?

Most residential properties in Eastern Hillsides are freehold (fee simple) or freehold strata, though select developments in the broader Chilliwack and Cultus Lake region sit on prepaid leasehold land. Always check the Title Type field on each MLS® listing and review the title search with your Realtor and lawyer.
